name: windy-plugin-cma-typhoon
description: Windy plugin for tracking typhoon with CMA data and 17-level Beaufort scale

scripts.build: powershell -Command "$env:SERVE='false'; $env:CONFIG='src'; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist -EA SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist -Force; npx rollup -c; Copy-Item package.json dist/"
scripts.build:all-examples: for number in 01 02 03 04 05 06; do CONFIG=example$number SERVE=false rollup -c; done

author: Windyty, S.E.
